answer: Practically, the chain should let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because sparrow only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. In practice relic is enforced by the ledger itself: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any willow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
